editorial: Surprised that a simple after school hangout could double as a stealth field mission, you find yourself crunching numbers next to the kids as they discover an underground lair. The film blends a suburban backdrop with a hidden lair that feels like a giant comic-book dream. A hidden gadget that converts everyday school supplies into superhero gear charms your imagination and keeps the tension rising. A mid-section slump in pacing slightly dampens the escalating tension. If you're craving a fresh family-friendly superhero adventure that balances wit with wonder, this will keep you engaged.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of family-friendly superhero adventures and witty teen comedies.
watchReasons: heart-pounding action in an attic lair
unexpected humor from everyday pocket items
